neighbours.label: a word that is about to give a length of time (' span', ' anywhere' from, a mean of, after an absence of), as opposed to other expressions of time
fire: Most horses have a working life span of 20 years.
The recession could last anywhere from two to 8 years.
The first phase lasts for anywhere from 3 to 10 days.
Patients were followed for a mean of 24 months.
She came home after an absence of ten years.
The tribe occupied the valley for a period of 300 years.
Treatment took anywhere between five and nine weeks.
The bird's average lifespan is about 15 years.
quiet: Most horses like a warm stable on cold nights.

Patients were seen on the first Friday of the month.
She came home for Christmas with her sons.
The tribe occupied the valley near the old river.

The bird's main food is small fish.
